en: The image is a stylized, illustrated postcard composed of four segments. The top segment depicts an old European castle or palace surrounded by greenery and a road leading up to it, with the text 'Wohlthätigkeits-Bazar'. The central segments (left and right) are artistic: one displays the large text 'BAZAR 1903' in art nouveau style, the other shows a cherubic figure drawing 'Glück' (luck) from a large container with coins and envelopes scattered around. The lower segment shows a woman at a table handing out letters, with a sign 'BAZAR 1903', and people standing in line in period clothing, framed in a festive, garlanded setting.
